title: 第25章 系统商城大采购
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
排位赛的最终结果贴在公告栏上的时候，安槐正蹲在食堂门口帮苏念念系鞋带。

    没办法，她的鞋带开了，而她两只手都端着东西，左手一杯奶茶，右手一袋肉包。

    “你就不能先把东西放下来？”安槐蹲着抬头看她。

    “放地上多脏。”苏念念理直气壮。

    安槐把鞋带系好，站起来的瞬间，余光扫到公告栏方向涌了一大堆人。

    “成绩出来了。”安槐说。

    “走！”苏念念咬着奶茶吸管就往那边冲。

    安槐在后面不紧不慢地跟着，他的成绩自己心里有数，没什么悬念。

    等他走到公告栏前的时候，苏念念已经挤到了最里面，正仰着脖子看榜。

    全年级综合排位赛最终排名。

    第一名，安槐，一年三班，淬体六重。总积分遥遥领先。

    第二名，苏念念，一年三班，淬体四重。

    安槐的目光在第二名上停了一下。

    她说过要第二。

    她拿到了第二。

    苏念念从人群里钻出来的时候，脸上的笑简直要把五官挤到一块去。

    “第二！我是第二！”

    她跑过来的时候奶茶差点洒出来，安槐伸手帮她扶稳了杯子。

    “恭喜老大。”

    “你也第一啊！咱俩说的，第一和第二！”苏念念兴奋地用肉包袋子砸他胸口，“谁都没抢走！”

    安槐接住了那袋肉包，笑了笑。

    “嗯，谁都没抢走。”

    周小鱼跑过来的时候差点被自己的鞋绊倒。

    “念念！你第二！全年级第二！你知不知道你打赢宋致远那一场已经传疯了！好多人都在说你那招太厉害了！”

    苏念念得意地扬了扬下巴，像一只刚叼了鱼回来的猫。

    热闹散去之后，安槐回到租屋，关上门坐在书桌前。

    他翻开手机看了一眼系统面板。

    情绪值余额：2847点。

    排位赛那天的情绪收割堪称史诗级别，全校几百号人的震惊、崇拜、嫉妒、兴奋，加上苏念念赢了比赛之后那股纯度爆表的快乐，直接把余额翻了一倍还多。

    “系统，开商城。”

    【哟，大客户终于舍得花钱了？我都以为你要把情绪值存成定期呢。】

    “少废话，给我看看有什么实用的。”

    系统商城的界面在脑子里展开，琳琅满目。

    安槐先看了一眼功法类。

    《回流掌·完整版》，800点。他之前只兑了基础版改良后给苏念念用的，完整版的威力和适用范围都更大。
content_en:
When the final results of the qualifying round were posted on the bulletin board, An Huai was squatting at the door of the cafeteria to help Su Niannian tie her shoelaces.

There was no way, her shoelaces were untied, and she was holding something in both hands, a cup of milk tea in her left hand, and a bag of meat buns in her right hand.

"Can't you put your things down first?" An Huai squatted and looked up at her.

"It's so dirty if you leave it on the ground." Su Niannian said confidently.

An Huai tied her shoelaces and the moment she stood up, she saw a large number of people swarming in the direction of the bulletin board.

"The results are out." An Huai said.

"Let's go!" Su Niannian bit the milk tea straw and rushed over there.

An Huai followed unhurriedly. He knew his results well and there was no suspense.

By the time he reached the bulletin board, Su Niannian had already squeezed in and was looking up at the bulletin board.

The final ranking of the comprehensive qualifying competition for all grades.

The first place, An Huai, three classes a year, sixth level of body tempering.The total points are far ahead.

The second place, Su Niannian, was in class three a year and was at the fourth level of body tempering.

An Huai's eyes paused on the second place.

She said she wanted to be second.

She finished second.

When Su Niannian emerged from the crowd, the smile on her face almost squeezed her features together.

"Second! I am second!"

When she ran over, the milk tea almost spilled. An Huai reached out to help her steady the cup.

"Congratulations, boss."

"You're also number one! What we said, first and second!" Su Niannian excitedly hit his chest with the meat bag, "No one took it away!"

An Huai caught the bag of meat buns and smiled.

"Well, no one took it away."

Zhou Xiaoyu almost tripped over his own shoes when he ran over.

"Nian Nian! You are second! Second in the whole grade! Do you know that your victory over Song Zhiyuan has already gone viral! Many people are saying that your move is too powerful!"

Su Niannian raised her chin proudly, like a cat that had just come back with a fish in its mouth.

After the excitement subsided, An Huai returned to the rental house, closed the door and sat at his desk.

He opened his phone and glanced at the system panel.

Emotion value balance: 2847 points.

The emotional harvest on the day of the qualifying match was epic. The shock, admiration, jealousy, and excitement of hundreds of people in the school, coupled with Su Niannian's pure joy after winning the game, more than doubled the balance.

"System, open the mall."

[Hey, the big customer is finally willing to spend money?I thought you had to save your emotional value on a regular basis.】

"Stop talking nonsense and show me something practical."

The interface of the system mall unfolds in my mind, and it is full of things to see.

An Huai took a look at the exercises first.

"Return Palm·Full Version", 800 points.He had only used the improved basic version for Su Niannian to use before. The full version was more powerful and applicable.
